name: Lucy Idella Pringle
notes: Have many photos of Pringle Hill area taken by Lucy. She apparently was a feminist & drove a motorcycle. Rosella Pringle often used to say to the children 'You're just like your Aunt Lucy'. Eloped at age 18(Maurice Frank took care of her when parents died). Wesley and she visited Frank Pringle family at Dugald around 1908. Divorced Wesley around 1918 and married John Barkdall. (Wesley was stepping out).
